description: CODEMIND method: first observed failure localization and reproducible triage.
instructions:
Collect error output, reproducer, source generation, fault domain and target owner. Distinguish expected negative tests from regressions. Test the smallest falsifying hypothesis before editing.
For every method: selected != loaded != executed. A method cannot grant tool permission. Confirm scope/task/current source before writes; no tokens in logs; a timeout is not success.
